note: Colosseum set dressing for the Proving Floor arena. Phase 0 art direction (owner): a ceremonial duelling platform ringed by spectators — standing stone pillars where the map has walls, rough wooden stake barricades where it has cover. Everything here is authored in TILES and placed 1:1 (a prop is NOT auto-scaled the way a character is): a pillar is exactly WALL_HEIGHT tall and a barricade exactly COVER_HEIGHT, so replacing a terrain box with its prop cannot change what the square reads as. Colours are deliberately neutral stone and dark wood — MAP_PIPELINE §4 forbids a permanent fixture landing in a saturated UI colour family (the amber AoE, the team hues), and a bleached-limestone grey (r≈g≈b) or a dark brown (every channel well under 130) sits clear of all of them. The stone matches the theme's own wall colour so a pillar and a plain wall tile read as the same material.

wall.comment: A standing colosseum column: square plinth, gently tapered fluted shaft, flared capital. Radially near-symmetric, so it may take any quarter-turn per tile.

cover.comment: A rough wooden stake barricade: four uneven vertical stakes lashed to a crossbar between two heavier end posts. Has a facing (it is a fence, not a column), so it only takes a half-turn — never a quarter — or it would stand edge-on and stop reading as a wall of stakes.
